title: Help us improve Boardsesh?
body: Allow product analytics, performance diagnostics and optional session replay to help us see what works. No thanks keeps them off. Your choice applies wherever you are signed in, and you can change it anytime.
settingsBody: Choose whether to share product analytics and performance diagnostics. You can keep climbing with either choice.
syncError: Your choice is saved here. We will sync it to your account when you are back online.
